snippet.title: PlayStation - NuPa - Numeric Paint Puzzle (1996)
snippet.description:
DESCRIPTION
NuPa: Numeric Paint Puzzle is a Puzzle game, developed by Jupiter Corporation and published by Tomy Corporation, which was released in Japan in 1996.
